data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.title: suggest
sections.question: suggest
sections.summary: to mention an idea or plan for someone to think about or consider

senses.definition: to mention an idea or plan for someone to think about or consider
examples: She suggested meeting for coffee on Saturday morning.
He suggested taking the bus instead of walking to the station in the rain.

answers.answer: She suggested meeting for coffee on Saturday morning.
He suggested the soup with salt and pepper before serving it.
She suggested the door shut because the noise from outside was too loud.
They suggested their bags on the floor and sat down at the table.

sections.title: thank
sections.question: thank
sections.summary: to tell someone that you are grateful for something they have done

senses.definition: to tell someone that you are grateful because they have helped you or done something kind
examples: She thanked her teacher for all the help with her project.
He thanked his neighbour for looking after the cat while he was away.

answers.answer: She thanked her teacher for all the help with her project.
He thanked his car after the long journey.
She thanked her coat because it kept her warm in the cold.
They thanked the television and turned it off before going to bed.
